rationale: Create one manager-level QScale platform record. Goldman Sachs Alternatives completed a control acquisition on May 13, 2026 as the first investment of West Street Infrastructure Partners V, while QScale's founders and management retained a minority interest. Aligned Data Centers, Investissement Québec and Desjardins Capital exited in that transaction. Q01 buildings, campus subsidiaries and financing counterparties are not separate portfolio companies. No later platform sale, recapitalization, exit or signed pending ownership transaction was identified through August 19, 2026.

afterImage.name: QScale
afterImage.description: QScale is a Canadian data-center platform developing energy-efficient infrastructure for artificial-intelligence, high-performance-computing, cloud and enterprise workloads. Its Q01 campus in Lévis, Québec markets 142 MW of power capacity and 114 MW of protected IT load, supported by an owned 266 MVA 2N substation, hydro-dominated power, liquid and free cooling, and waste-heat reuse. Goldman Sachs Alternatives completed a control acquisition on May 13, 2026 as the first investment of West Street Infrastructure Partners V; founders and management retained a minority interest. Aligned Data Centers, Investissement Québec and Desjardins Capital exited in that transaction. Exact current percentages and the acquisition vehicle are not publicly disclosed, and no later ownership transaction or signed pending exit was identified through August 19, 2026.
